sourceOfTruthRules: Public TOTJO text pages may be used in V1 when attribution and source review records are recorded.
Member-only or private TOTJO content must not be bundled, synced, or shipped in V1.
Knight's Code and other bonus materials stay in the supplemental reading collection for companion study.
Bundled doctrine, sermons, and sounds must not ship without recorded source review details.
Personalized text is display-only and must never replace stored source text.
releaseBlockers: Missing source review details for any shippable text or sound asset.
Missing recorded attribution for any shippable text or sound asset.
Any bundled doctrine entry that is not sourced from the recorded public doctrine material.
Any use of private or member-only TOTJO content.
